detail.reason:

The command serves bead schema explain SCHEMA_REF with --format json and markdown (src/cli.rs SchemaCommand::Explain, src/main.rs cmd_schema). Tests assert both renderings agree (renderer parity — Markdown is the rendering of the exact JSON the CLI emitted — plus whole-catalog determinism and per-format byte digests) and the SNAPSHOT_GUIDE_VERSION tripwire fails any rendered-contract change until FIELD_GUIDE_VERSION bumps with it. No file changes were made and none were needed — nothing staged, nothing new to record in git. The pre-existing dirty .beads checkpoint churn and containers/bead-rs-ci-builder/Dockerfile belong to other workers and were left untouched.
